children: Ming Zhou disclosed a 20.2% stake in GOLDENWELL BIOTECH, INC.’s common stock. On Oct. 8, 2026, CEO Shuang Liu gifted her 20,000,000 shares, and she joined the board the same day. The Oct. 9, 2026 Schedule 13D underscores her new board role and sizable ownership.
Zhou says she holds the shares for investment and now sits on Goldenwell Biotech’s board following her Oct. 8 appointment. "Ms. Zhou was appointed a director of the Issuer."

She may buy more shares in the open market or in private deals, or sell some or all of her stake, as conditions change. She states no current plans for major corporate actions, noting, "Ms. Zhou holds the shares of common stock of the Issuer, as described in Item 3 herein, for investment purposes."

Ming Zhou is a China-born business executive who serves as President of Get Health Co., Ltd. in Samutprakan, Thailand. She works in the health sector and joined Goldenwell Biotech’s board on Oct. 8, 2026. As an individual investor, she intends to review the investment over time and may adjust her holdings as opportunities arise.
